title: SessionKeysParams
description: Write one step under a target session.read minted for a worker you spawned (or one of its own workers): exactly one of key, text or option. A sequence is not one call — key is a single key name, never a list — so send one key, read the result, then decide the next one. tokenId is the target's tokenId from session.read, and it is spent at most once.

sessionId.description: The worker whose pane to write to, exactly as session.read read it.

tokenId.description: The target's tokenId, from session.read's target.tokenId. It authorizes exactly this one step, against the exact frame session.read classified.

key.description: One physical key: Enter, Esc, Tab, BackTab, Backspace, Delete, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Insert, F1-F12, Space, or one chord Ctrl+<letter>, Alt+<key> or Shift+<key> (for example Ctrl+C). Never a list or a comma-joined sequence — two keys are two calls.

text.description: One atom of text, written as a paste — never submitted by itself. A newline or other control character is refused unless the program has bracketed paste on.

option.description: An option's text exactly as session.read's target.menu.options showed it. Valid only for a menu target: nocx moves the selection to it and confirms, one key at a time, and refuses if the menu changes underneath the call.

result.title: SessionKeysResult
result.description: What became of the step. A refusal is an answer too: nothing was written, and refusal.cause says why. failed_partial and delivery_unknown carry a true bytesWritten; every other state's bytesWritten is 0 or absent.

sessionId.description: The session this step was sent to.

state.description: executed: the step was written and confirmed. refused: nothing was written; see refusal. failed_partial: some bytes reached the program, then the write failed. delivery_unknown: the write's completion was never reported (a shutdown mid-flight). cancelled: withdrawn before it committed. in_progress: an earlier attempt on the same token is still resolving; ask again shortly. indeterminate: this step's outcome could not be learned even after its deadline passed — it may or may not have reached the pane; look at the pane before acting again.

bytesWritten.description: Bytes actually written. Present and meaningful chiefly for failed_partial and delivery_unknown.

steps.description: How many keys this call actually sent. 1 for a plain key or text atom; more for an option, which moves the selection one step at a time before confirming.

refusal.description: Present only when state is refused.

cause.description: stale_target: the screen (or, for an option, the menu) moved since the target was minted. incomparable: the buffer, geometry or incarnation changed since the snapshot. expired: the target's 60s lifetime passed. forged: the token does not belong to this call's authority. token_spent: this token already carries a different canonical intent. snapshot_gone: the target's snapshot aged out of the helper's ring. completeness_unknown: the helper's own reply reserve overflowed and it can no longer state the screen's completeness. cannot_encode: this text cannot be turned into bytes the terminal's own modes accept. would_submit: a newline or control byte in text with bracketed paste off. access_revoked: this session's access epoch moved past what this step was admitted under. no_read_barrier: this session has no read barrier (an SSH channel today) and refuses every state-changing step. commit_deadline: this step reached its commit point after its own deadline. capacity: this session already holds the maximum number of live targets. busy: this session's intent queue is full. closing: this session is shutting down and admits nothing new.

regionNow.description: What the target's rows read right now, present only on the response that produced this refusal.

regionTruncated.description: True when regionNow was cut to its 16 KiB bound.
